name: Conversations
menuDescription: Find your agents and pick up a conversation
title: A conversation with your agents.
description: Talk to agents, attach files, and search messages in the native Polymux app.
intro: The native app keeps your conversation list and selected chat close together. Find an agent, send a request, and follow its responses and activity without the older tabbed workspace.

demoItems.label: Find
demoItems.title: Your conversation list
demoItems.description: Search names and roles, filter unread chats, or sort by activity.

demoItems.label: Ask
demoItems.title: Messages and attachments
demoItems.description: Send a request with the files it needs.

demoItems.label: Follow
demoItems.title: Replies and activity
demoItems.description: Review responses and answer requests for your approval.

benefits.title: Find the right chat
benefits.description: Use sidebar search, unread and active filters, and name or recent sorting.

benefits.title: Keep the reference
benefits.description: Reply to a message and search within the selected conversation.

benefits.title: Bring the file
benefits.description: Attach files from the composer, or drop them into a chat on macOS.

steps: Connect the app to your running agent server.
Choose a conversation or create one with New Chat.
Send a request and follow its replies, activity, and approval cards.

example.title: Plan the next step
example.description: Ask your agent to help turn a project brief into a short list of priorities, then keep refining the plan in the same conversation.

name: Groups
menuDescription: Bring several agents into the same conversation
title: Give the conversation a team.
description: Create native Polymux group chats with several agents and a shared name.
intro: Choose several agents when starting a chat to create a group. Give it a name, keep the discussion in one place, and edit its membership from the conversation header as the work changes.

demoItems.label: Choose
demoItems.title: Select your agents
demoItems.description: Add recipients in New Chat.

demoItems.label: Name
demoItems.title: Set a shared purpose
demoItems.description: Give the group an optional chat name.

demoItems.label: Adjust
demoItems.title: Edit the group
demoItems.description: Open the header to change its name and members.

benefits.title: Work together
benefits.description: Include up to 16 agents in a conversation.

benefits.title: Keep it recognisable
benefits.description: Use a group name to distinguish the discussion from individual chats.

benefits.title: Change the team
benefits.description: Edit group membership without creating another workspace.

steps: Open New Chat and choose more than one agent.
Add an optional group name and press Create.
Use the group header when you need to edit its name or membership.

example.title: Discuss a project
example.description: Bring a planning agent and a writing agent into a group to discuss a brief. Group membership is distinct from delegating a bounded child task.

name: Agent profiles
menuDescription: Shape each agent's identity and instructions
title: Make each agent recognisable.
description: Edit an agent's name, role, role description, avatar, and schedule controls.
intro: An agent profile gives your conversation a recognisable identity and purpose. Edit its name, role, instructions, and avatar in the native app, with schedule controls alongside the profile.

demoItems.label: Identity
demoItems.title: Name and avatar
demoItems.description: Recognise the agent in the list and chat header.

demoItems.label: Purpose
demoItems.title: Role description
demoItems.description: Describe what the agent should do and how it should respond.

demoItems.label: Schedule
demoItems.title: Background work
demoItems.description: Review routines and the background-review toggle.

benefits.title: Describe the job
benefits.description: Keep an agent's role and working instructions in its profile.

benefits.title: Choose its look
benefits.description: Customise the avatar from the profile editor.

benefits.title: Review its routines
benefits.description: See scheduled work and cancel routines from the same panel.

steps: Open an individual agent conversation.
Click the agent's header to open Edit profile.
Edit its details and press Save; use the avatar control for appearance.

example.title: A writing partner
example.description: Give an agent a writing role and describe the tone and review process you want. Model configuration remains a separate server setting.

name: Voice
menuDescription: Configure voice separately from text-agent models
title: Choose how you use voice.
description: Configure Cascaded or Full Duplex voice, Gemini models, and voice credentials in native Settings.
intro: The native Settings panel offers Cascaded and Full Duplex voice modes. Configure the applicable Gemini model and credentials there, separately from the text model used by the Go agent server.

demoItems.label: Mode
demoItems.title: Cascaded or Full Duplex
demoItems.description: Choose the voice mode in Settings.

demoItems.label: Provider
demoItems.title: Gemini configuration
demoItems.description: Set the applicable model, voice, and API key.

demoItems.label: Permission
demoItems.title: Microphone access
demoItems.description: Approve the operating-system access required by the feature.

benefits.title: Choose a mode
benefits.description: Use the native Voice controls rather than older provider-settings instructions.

benefits.title: Keep models separate
benefits.description: Voice settings do not replace the server's text-agent model configuration.

benefits.title: Grant access deliberately
benefits.description: Microphone and speech permissions are optional and apply only when using voice.

steps: Connect the app to your server and open Settings.
Choose a voice mode and configure its Gemini model and key.
Check the feature's status and required system permissions before using voice.

example.title: Choose your voice setup
example.description: Set up a voice mode without changing the model endpoint used for text conversations. Keep API keys out of chat messages.

name: Memory
menuDescription: Save useful notes within an agent conversation
title: Keep useful context for later.
description: Agents can save, recall, and forget conversation-scoped memory on the server.
intro: The Go server provides explicit memory tools for useful notes. Memory is scoped to an agent and conversation, stored in SQLite on the server, and kept separate from the app's conversation cache.

demoItems.label: Save
demoItems.title: A useful preference
demoItems.description: Ask the agent to remember something for this conversation.

demoItems.label: Recall
demoItems.title: Relevant notes
demoItems.description: The server retrieves notes within a bounded context budget.

demoItems.label: Forget
demoItems.title: Remove active memory
demoItems.description: Forgetting is separate from deleting history or backups.

benefits.title: Be explicit
benefits.description: Ask for a memory change and check the agent's result.

benefits.title: Respect the scope
benefits.description: Notes are not automatically shared with every agent or delegated child.

benefits.title: Know the location
benefits.description: A remote server stores memory on that server, not only on your app device.

steps: Ask an agent to save a useful note in your conversation.
Check that the memory operation succeeded.
Ask it to recall or forget the note when needed.

example.title: Keep a working preference
example.description: Ask an agent to remember your preferred review format for this conversation, rather than assuming every new chat shares the same memory.

name: Tasks & schedules
menuDescription: Schedule routines and delegate bounded work
title: Give work a time and a scope.
description: Ask agents for one-shot or interval routines and bounded delegated tasks on the server.
intro: Agents can schedule one-shot or interval routines and queue bounded child tasks. Review schedules in an agent's profile and follow work in the conversation, rather than looking for the older Tasks board.

demoItems.label: Routine
demoItems.title: A time to run
demoItems.description: Specify the task, start time, timezone, and interval.

demoItems.label: Review
demoItems.title: Background reviews
demoItems.description: Control periodic reviews from the agent's profile.

demoItems.label: Delegate
demoItems.title: A bounded child task
demoItems.description: A child receives its explicit task, not the whole parent chat.

benefits.title: Check the timing
benefits.description: Confirm the next run instead of assuming a calendar rule became a supported interval.

benefits.title: Control background work
benefits.description: Toggle background reviews or cancel a routine in Edit profile.

benefits.title: Keep delegation bounded
benefits.description: Children cannot recursively delegate and do not automatically receive private parent memory.

steps: Describe the work and its timing or delegation boundary in chat.
Review any approval and the confirmed schedule or task state.
Keep the server and required connections running, then check the result.

example.title: Review a brief later
example.description: Ask for a one-time reminder with an explicit time and timezone. Confirm the saved routine and cancel it from the agent profile if plans change.

name: Models & agents
menuDescription: Configure model access on your agent server
title: The model runs behind your server.
description: Configure the Go server's OpenAI-compatible model endpoint separately from agent profiles and voice.
intro: The app displays conversations while the Go server runs agents. Configure the text model's compatible endpoint and credentials on that server; agent profiles and native voice settings are separate controls.

demoItems.label: Server
demoItems.title: Text model
demoItems.description: Startup model.json or environment configuration.

demoItems.label: Agent
demoItems.title: Role and instructions
demoItems.description: Edit the agent's profile in the app.

demoItems.label: Voice
demoItems.title: Gemini voice settings
demoItems.description: Configure the applicable voice model in Settings.

benefits.title: Keep configuration clear
benefits.description: Know whether a problem belongs to the app connection, model endpoint, or agent instructions.

benefits.title: Keep secrets out of chat
benefits.description: Use server-side secret injection or an owner-only credential file.

benefits.title: Use current guidance
benefits.description: The native app has no general Providers, Models, or ACP settings page.

steps: Configure a compatible model endpoint and model identifier on the server.
Supply its credential through the server's supported secret configuration.
Connect the app and send a small request to verify a reply.

example.title: Diagnose the right connection
example.description: If conversations load but replies fail, inspect the server's model setup rather than searching the native app for an older Providers page.

name: Skills & tools
menuDescription: Connect trusted instructions and tools per agent
title: Give an agent the tools it needs.
description: Configure trusted Markdown skills and MCP connections for agents on the server.
intro: Skills provide working instructions and MCP connections provide external tools. Configure trusted integrations for the agent on its server, remembering that server paths and processes are not your app device's paths and processes.

demoItems.label: Skill
demoItems.title: Trusted Markdown
demoItems.description: Register an existing absolute Markdown path on the server.

demoItems.label: MCP
demoItems.title: Connected tools
demoItems.description: Use supported stdio or Streamable HTTP connections.

demoItems.label: Review
demoItems.title: Deliberate access
demoItems.description: Confirm the account, scope, and approval classification.

benefits.title: Configure the right agent
benefits.description: Integration changes are persisted per agent from a direct conversation.

benefits.title: Know where tools run
benefits.description: Stdio integrations run on the server computer.

benefits.title: Review changes
benefits.description: Saved definition changes become available on the next turn.

steps: Choose a trusted skill file or MCP service and its intended access.
Ask the agent in a direct chat to manage the integration and review setup decisions.
Use a new turn to check the saved configuration and available tools.

example.title: Use a repeatable review process
example.description: Register a trusted review skill already present on the server, then ask the agent to use it for the next task. No native Skills settings page is required.
